acceptance: On held-out cases: improve exact and reduce total FN, with no added FP and no worse exact/FP/FN for either language or any category. All calls must be valid. Then verify existing regression corpus before deployment.
independence: New synthetic wording frozen before execution; same investigator labels, not externally blind. Development cases reported separately. No prompt tuning after inspecting outcomes.
authority: Review only; never automatic task matching or confirmation.
